data.short_description: A new wine bar from restaurateur Lawrence Bondulich is set to open at the former Walter Hansel Wine Bar & Bistro location. An exact opening date has not been announced, though the website points to late summer 2026. The concept is inspired by Bondulich's former New York venture, Bin 71, and will offer Old World wines alongside house-made pastas and seasonal small plates.

A new neighborhood pub and sports bar is expected to open this summer in Downtown Oakland, taking over the former Dinner House space. Launched by chef Michelle Macqueen and bar owner Matt Sturm, the concept will offer elevated cocktails and soulful comfort food. The owners previously debuted Lucy Blue in Oakland in 2025.

data.store_name: Candy Land Cafe (pop-up at Bayside Kitchen + Bar)
data.short_description: An interactive dining pop-up inspired by the classic Candy Land board game is set to open for a limited run at Bayside Kitchen + Bar in San Diego. Created by Bucket Listers in collaboration with Hasbro, the experience will feature themed environments, candy-inspired food and drinks, and interactive activities. San Diego was selected as the launch city for this first-ever Candy Land Cafe concept.

data.location: 2550 Fifth Ave, Suite 120, San Diego, CA 92103
data.short_description: Urban Kitchen Group, led by Tracy Borkum and chef Tim Kolanko, is planning a new all-day restaurant concept in San Diego's Bankers Hill neighborhood at the long-vacant former home of Civico by the Park and Il Dandy. The approximately 5,000-square-foot indoor-outdoor project's name, menu, and design details have not yet been announced. The project marks a return to UKG's roots in Bankers Hill.

Hap's Burgers & Taps is preparing to open a second location in Downtown Seattle, though an exact address and opening date have not yet been announced. The restaurant currently operates from Mercer Island at 2411 76th Ave SE and recently joined Conscious Hospitality Group. The concept serves classic burgers, fries, shakes, and beverages with an emphasis on locally sourced and Pacific Northwest ingredients.

The Shout! House dueling piano bar is undergoing an ownership transition, with longtime Entertainment Manager Eric Blumenfeld taking over from CHW Entertainment after more than two decades. The concept, branding, and name will remain unchanged, and the venue will continue its dueling piano performances, food, and nightlife experience. No closing or reopening date was mentioned.

data.short_description: Tex-Mex fast-casual restaurant Barrio Burrito Bar is opening two new locations in Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The Airline Highway location is expected to open between mid-July and early August and will be a standalone restaurant attached to CC's Coffee House. The concept offers customizable burritos, bowls, and tacos with 10 proteins and multiple house-made sauces.

data.status: expected to open in about a month
data.short_description: The second Baton Rouge location of Barrio Burrito Bar is expected to open in approximately one month, per the company's website. The fast-casual Tex-Mex concept offers customizable burritos, bowls, and tacos. Master franchiser Marc Johnson oversees the Louisiana and Alabama territory.

data.location: 306 E Liberty Ave, Round Rock, TX 78664
data.short_description: Yaya's Restaurant, led by Miguel Salas and Dino López, will open at 306 E Liberty Avenue in Round Rock, offering Southern cuisine with a Mexican Tex-Mex infusion. Construction on the building is expected to begin in June with completion anticipated by June 2027, and the owners aim to open in December 2027. The 120-seat restaurant will also offer catering, an event room, and a private balcony.

data.status: aiming to open toward the end of 2026 or possibly in January 2027
data.short_description: A new large-scale live entertainment venue called Ramona Music Hall is planned near Sacramento State, featuring approximately 21,000 square feet of theater space, indoor and outdoor restaurants, and a soccer and rugby field. The venue is expected to hold up to 3,000 guests and will be developed inside two existing warehouse buildings. The project has been in the works for several years as part of a larger effort to bring a major entertainment destination to Sacramento.

data.status: aiming to open by the end of July
data.short_description: A dual-concept dining destination combining an American bistro (The Ari) and a cocktail lounge (The Lloyd) is preparing to debut in Old Town Scottsdale by the end of July, pending final inspections and construction milestones. The concept comes from local couple Katie Schnurr and Stephen Roach, who are transforming Roach's former cabinetry showroom. Chef Devan Cunningham is behind the culinary program, which will feature approachable American fare and craft cocktails.

Chef Michael Toscano is opening a new all-day café called The Larrikin at 157 Market Street in Charleston, featuring a coffee-focused menu with beans sourced from multiple specialty roasters alongside beer, wine, spirits, and grain bowls. An official opening date has not yet been announced; once open, the café will operate from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. The concept expands Toscano's existing Charleston portfolio, which includes Le Farfalle, Da Toscano Porchetta Shop, Fugazzi, and Blanca Estrada.

Einstein Bros Bagels is set to open at a new ground-up retail strip development in Spring, TX, with construction slated to start in late August and wrap up at the end of January 2027. The $350,000 construction project is expected to result in an opening in early 2027. The new location will likely feature the brand's new "Elevate the Morning" store design.

data.short_description: Beard Papa's Japanese-inspired cream puff bakery is closing its Las Vegas location after four years of operation, having opened the South Rainbow Blvd location in 2022. The bakery team announced the closure on social media on May 19, offering no specific reason for the shutdown. The team thanked the Las Vegas community for their support over the years.

Bill Miller Bar-B-Q confirmed via social media that its Wurzbach Road location will close on May 24, with no specific reason given for the shutdown. Two other Huebner Road locations in San Antonio will remain open. The San Antonio-based BBQ chain has operated since 1950 and runs more than 76 restaurants across San Antonio, Austin, and Corpus Christi.

Burr & Berry is preparing to open a fourth Charlotte-area location at 2905 Monroe Road near Elizabeth, between Tipsy Burro and Smokey Joe's Café. Co-owner Jason Cowan confirmed the late summer target timeline in a recent interview. The locally owned drive-thru coffee concept launched its first location in Indian Land in 2019 and has since expanded with locations on South Boulevard and Monroe Road in southeast Charlotte.

Gori & Co. is set to open at the former home of Bluefin in Jamaica Plain, bringing what the owner describes as Boston's first kakigōri-inspired café. Owner Delasie Dela-Seshie Jr. will offer a seasonally rotating menu of ultra-finely shaved Japanese ice topped with house-made syrups, locally sourced fruit, and layered toppings. No official opening date has been announced.

data.short_description: Amy's Burgers filed a City of Las Vegas permit for a potential first brick-and-mortar location at the Longford Shoppes at Summerlin Parkway, but owner Amy Samaritano confirmed the deal has not been finalized and may not proceed. The concept currently operates as a food truck and ghost kitchen out of the Summerlin Takeout. A brick-and-mortar location is described as coming in the near future, though no confirmed address or date exists.

Utopia Bagels opened its fourth location in Midtown East on May 17, 2026, in a 2,700-square-foot space on the ground floor of 875 Third Avenue. The shop bakes more than 1,000 bagels per hour and offered free bagels to its first 100 customers on opening day. It is open daily from 6 a.m. to 4 p.m.

Signage is already up and construction is currently underway at the site. The development team confirmed the new Sbarro is slated to open by this summer.

Segafredo L'Originale, an Italian cafe and cocktail bar on Lincoln Road, announced via social media that it will serve its final meal on June 21, 2026, after 26 years in operation. The team did not share an official reason for the closure but posted an emotional farewell message to the community.

data.store_name: Harlow & Pearl (flagship — The Starlight Motor Inn)
data.short_description: Harlow & Pearl, a specialty coffee concept owned by Nichole Tupas, has expanded from a mobile coffee bar into a brick-and-mortar business, with a flagship location already open inside The Starlight Motor Inn. Two additional locations are expected to open this summer at 769 Meeting St. and 1064 Clement Ferry Rd. in the Charleston area. Each shop will have its own distinct personality and specialty menu.

data.location: 769 Meeting St., Charleston, SC (zip not specified)
data.short_description: A second Harlow & Pearl location is planned for 769 Meeting St. with a "girly, Barbie-inspired" theme and Barbie-themed specialty drinks. The downtown location is expected to open in mid-June 2026.

data.location: 1064 Clement Ferry Rd., Charleston, SC (zip not specified)
data.short_description: A third Harlow & Pearl location is planned for 1064 Clement Ferry Rd., set in a ranch-style home designed to feel like a time capsule blending elements from the other two shops. It is expected to open in July 2026.

Patio is a new cafe and bistro concept planned for 1800 S Wabash Ave in Chicago's Near South Side, offering upscale Mediterranean cuisine with coffee, brunch, cocktails, and late-night service. Owner Shahriar Farokhi is planning a soft opening in mid-June followed by a full opening in July, with the bistro component to follow. The restaurant is currently under construction.

Nomikai by Sushi Saint is a new sister concept from the team behind Michelin Bib Gourmand-awarded Sushi Saint, set to open at Icon Park on International Drive in Orlando. The restaurant will expand on Sushi Saint's sushi program by adding hot dishes, large protein plates, and shareable items in a "Tokyo neo-cyberpunk" interior with seating for approximately 60 guests. An opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 2002 S Harbor City Blvd, Melbourne, FL 32901
data.short_description: Baked by Chelle is a bakery concept from owner Michelle Franzen and her twin brother, planned for 2002 S Harbor City Blvd in downtown Melbourne, FL. The bakery will offer authentic Italian pastries, Italian-American pastries, Italian cookies, cinnamon rolls, cannolis, and possibly bread. Renovations are currently underway and an opening date has not been announced.

Mr. Pan is a new restaurant planned for Lakeview Plaza at 2312 Fortune Rd in Kissimmee, FL, confirmed by one of its owners, Angelica. No further details about the menu or opening date were shared at this time, though the article notes the name suggests a Latin bakery concept.

data.status: expecting to open later this fall
data.short_description: Roseline Coffee is preparing to open a new cafe at the former Starbucks location at 2803 E. Burnside Street in Portland, which will become its eighth Oregon location. The company is currently submitting permit requests to the city, with co-founder Keith Schuman stating the team expects to open later this fall. The new space will offer approximately 1,600 square feet.

Brothers Jared and Josh Van Dyke are planning a new family-friendly casual dining restaurant on Vilano Beach at 2931 Coastal Hwy, inspired by New England beachside restaurants. The as-yet-unnamed concept will feature fresh, healthy food, cocktails, and live music in a 2,500-square-foot indoor space with outdoor seating. If all goes well, an opening could be expected in between one and two years' time.

data.store_name: The White Tee Indoor Golf Club
data.short_description: The White Tee Indoor Golf Club, a private members-only indoor golf concept, plans to open this summer at 11041 SR 54 in Odessa, FL. The facility will feature 16-foot premium golf bays with augmented reality swing data, a lounge, putting green, members bar, and a restaurant component. Plan review documents have been submitted and the venue is currently under construction.

data.status: opening date has not been announced yet
data.short_description: Benihana will open its first fast-casual concept, Benihana Express, at 1380 16th Street in downtown Denver, occupying 3,000 square feet on the ground floor of the 16M Building. The fast-casual format will deliver Benihana's staples in a counter-service setting rather than the traditional teppanyaki sit-down experience. An opening date has not been announced yet.

Call Your Mother Deli has filed permits for a 1,578-square-foot build-out at 5074 E. Hampden Avenue in Denver's Happy Canyon Shopping Center, taking over a former Starbucks space. The project includes a full commercial kitchen, a 14-seat dining area, and 16-seat patio. Owner Andrew Dana confirmed they are still in early stages and could not provide an opening date.

Jimmy Blue Eyes is a new restaurant concept planned for Suite 1140 at Countryside Mall at 27001 US Highway 19 N in Clearwater, FL, per plan review documents submitted by JBE 101 LLC. The owners, Ryan and Mark Johnston, were not available for comment, and menu details have not been confirmed, though a MapQuest listing references a "Jimmy Blue Eyes Taco & Tequila" concept.

Celebrity chef Aarthi Sampath opened Drāvida, her first restaurant, in the East Village on May 21, 2026, at 211 1st Ave. The restaurant offers a chef-driven, multi-floor dining experience rooted in South Asian and diasporic cuisine, housed in a restored building with original brick ovens. It also features Jam and Jaggery, a speakeasy located within the space.

Bizarre Coffee Company is preparing to open its fourth location at 4415 Cherokee Street in Downtown Acworth, GA, joining existing shops in Canton, Woodstock, and Roswell. A recent Instagram post shows the historic building under construction with an announcement that the location is months away from opening. The brand is known for its colorful atmosphere, art-inspired identity, and coffee and breakfast menu.

data.location: 515 W 38th St, 2nd Floor, New York, NY 10018
data.short_description: Indienne, a Michelin-starred Indian restaurant originally launched in Chicago's River North neighborhood in 2022, will open its New York location at 515 West 38th Street, 2nd Floor inside Henry Hall in Hudson Yards on May 28, 2026. The restaurant will feature 34 seats and continue its signature multi-course tasting menu with nine-course options priced at $175–$195.

The Cheesecake Factory will open its first Forsyth County location on July 21, 2026, at The Collection at 410 Peachtree Pkwy in Cumming, GA. The opening is expected to bring 280 jobs to the area and will be the chain's sixth location in the Atlanta area.

Atlanta-based Italian restaurant Yeppa & Co. is planning its first out-of-state expansion with a location inside the Caption by Hyatt hotel at 118 12th Avenue South in Nashville's Gulch neighborhood. The concept's website lists the Nashville location as "coming 2027," though a more specific opening timeline has not been announced. Yeppa & Co. is known for handmade pastas, focaccia-style flatbreads, seafood dishes, and Italian shareable plates.

VIVIBOWL is a fast-casual Mexican-Asian fusion brand announcing its U.S. debut with a first location on Park Avenue in NYC. An upcoming location at 295 Madison Avenue and one in Santa Monica, LA are slated for late 2026. The brand also plans collaborations with Michelin-starred chefs as it expands.

Kitchen + Kocktails by Kevin Kelley, a Dallas-based elevated soul food chain, is opening a 10,000-square-foot two-level flagship in Times Square in the former Pink Taco space. The menu will feature dishes like Fried Chicken and Waffles and Shrimp and Grits, with an average customer bill of around $75. No exact opening date is provided.

The former Upper East Side restaurant Ship of Fools is relaunching in Hell's Kitchen at 867 9th Ave after closing due to a landlord dispute. The relaunched venue will be an all-day restaurant and bar serving classic American fare and breakfast. Owners Glenn and Owen Treacher are seeking a full liquor license with planned hours ending at 2 a.m.

The Grog Frog Wine & Spirits, a new experiential and curated liquor store concept, will open in Cummins Station in downtown Nashville on June 5. Co-owned by Daniel Ochoterena and Robby Van Fossen, the store will offer curated bottle selections, mixology education, tastings, and a loyalty program.

Serafina Restaurant Group is opening Brasserie Cognac Américain at 461 Fifth Avenue, a nearly 12,000-square-foot French-American grand brasserie developed with Chef Michael Lomonaco. The menu centers on French brasserie classics with a modern American lens and seasonal ingredients. No exact opening date is specified.

A new restaurant called Vita 4400 is planned for 4400 Charlotte Avenue in Nashville's Sylvan Park neighborhood, with a permit filed for interior updates. The project is affiliated with Anthony Sanfilippo and Jake Sudduth, who purchased the property for $3 million in October 2023. Menu, design, and opening timeline details are not yet available.

Gato Exotico, a new concept from the Wusong Road team, hosted a What Now Media Group "Accelerate" networking event at its Cambridge location. The article focuses on the industry event rather than the restaurant's opening details. No opening date is specified.

Pura Vida, a Miami-based lifestyle cafe chain, has leased space at The Gateway at Wynwood at 2916 N. Miami Avenue for its first Wynwood location and is also relocating its corporate headquarters there. The cafe opening is not expected until mid-2027, per South Florida Business Journal. The brand currently operates more than 50 locations across the U.S.

Devil's Hideaway, a neighborhood cocktail bar and restaurant in Tempe, hosted a What Now Media Group "Accelerate" networking event for Phoenix hospitality professionals. The article focuses on the industry event and does not provide opening details for Devil's Hideaway. No opening or closing event is described.

Owner Carlos Donato hopes to debut the new location in about a month, pending construction. The menu includes tacos, burritos, soups, nachos, and taco dinners.

BOL Hospitality Group is opening Common Room at 2032 Harrison Street in Downtown Hollywood, featuring premium American classics led by executive chef Tanya Evans and a cocktail program by Unfiltered Hospitality. The venue includes a hidden invite-only speakeasy called the Brooklyn Room. An exact opening date has not been announced.

data.short_description: Curry N Jerk Authentic Caribbean Cuisine is opening a new location inside the FedEx World Hub facility in Memphis. An opening timeline is not currently available, and it is unclear how the new location will differ from its current 150 Munroe Avenue home.

Del Sur Bakery in Ravenswood is temporarily closing on June 14 so construction can begin on a larger space. Owner Justin Lerias hopes to reopen around July, with plans to add more seating and production space. The closure is for expansion purposes only.

data.location: 75 John Wesley Dobbs Ave NE, Atlanta, GA 30303
data.short_description: Ché René Macarons will open a pop-up at Studio House Atlanta at 75 John Wesley Dobbs Ave NE, Suite 100 in June, timed around the World Cup. The pop-up is expected to remain open beyond the summer, likely through the end of the year. The brand is known for French macarons with a Southern twist.

Sinfully Sweet Keto has signed a lease for a new location at 2750 Jiles Rd, Suite 117 in Kennesaw. Founded in 2021 by Kelli Sterling, the brand specializes in sugar-free, gluten-free, and low-carb baked goods. An exact opening timeline has not been announced.

data.short_description: IJ Sushi Burrito is expanding to the Los Angeles area with its first Southern California location at Westfield Topanga in Canoga Park, opening in mid-June. The Washington-born brand offers customizable sushi burritos, poke bowls, and salad bowls.
A second Los Angeles–area IJ Sushi Burrito location is under construction at Westfield Culver City and expected to open in September 2026.
A third Los Angeles–area IJ Sushi Burrito location is planned for Westfield Century City, with no address or opening date specified in the article.

Vertical Diner has announced the permanent closure of its Portland location, with its final dinner service on June 14 after 7 years of operation. The team cited rising costs and unsustainable operating expenses as the reasons for closure. The original Salt Lake City location will remain open.

data.status: opening date has not yet been announced
data.short_description: Bar Caviar, owned by Ken and Vittoria Schutz, will open inside their boutique Dwight D Hotel at 256 S. 16th St. in Rittenhouse Square. The lounge will offer 50 champagne selections and five varieties of caviar, with pours ranging from $15 to approximately $600. No official opening date has been announced.

data.location: 1200 El Paseo de Saratoga, San Jose, CA 95129
data.short_description: Sweetgreen is opening a new 2,406 sq. ft. location in West San Jose's El Paseo de Saratoga on May 19, 2026. The restaurant will serve signature salads, warm bowls, and protein plates using locally sourced California produce. Preview events with complimentary meals were scheduled for May 15 and 16.

data.location: 1900 N. Highland Ave., Suite 6B, Los Angeles, CA 90068
data.short_description: Pita & Pie is seeking an ABC license for a new restaurant in the Hollywood area. Little information is known about the concept, including menu, design, or opening timeline. The concept is attributed to Amer Nackoud per the ABC permit filing.

data.status: expected to open in late spring
data.short_description: Austin food truck Espadas de Brazil is opening a brick-and-mortar Brazilian steakhouse in Bastrop in a space that formerly housed Stem & Stone. Owner Robinson Figueiredo announced hiring for the new location, and a "coming soon" post indicates the space is coming along. The restaurant will serve Brazilian dishes such as spicy garlic picanha and churrasco.

Seaviche Tacos & Bowls has signed a lease for a third location in Roseville, expanding its Metro Detroit presence beyond existing Detroit and White Lake locations. Owner Evan Shina does not have an opening date at this time. The Mexican seafood concept serves tacos, burritos, bowls, quesadillas, and family trays.

KP's Kitchen and Bar is closing its Bellaire location on May 31, 2026, with the owner citing a desire to focus on the original Spring Valley location. Owner Kerry Pauly shared an emotional farewell on social media, thanking the community for years of support. The Spring Valley location will remain open and continue operations.

data.status: plans pointing to a later 2026 opening
data.short_description: Burger chain Jaggers, operated by Texas Roadhouse, is preparing to open in the former Twin Peaks space near Hanes Mall Boulevard in Winston-Salem. The restaurant offers burgers, chicken sandwiches, salads, fries, and hand-spun milkshakes. The Winston-Salem location joins existing North Carolina locations in Fayetteville, Greenville, and Jacksonville.

Ike's Café & Grill hosted a ribbon-cutting and community celebration on May 8, 2026 at its new 3,200 sq. ft. Marietta location. The African-inspired full-service restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner, including jollof rice, suya, egusi soup, and grilled meats. The opening marks the brand's expansion from its 2025 ghost kitchen concept into a brick-and-mortar location.

Harvey's Deli, a family-owned sandwich shop in Katy, announced its sudden closure on social media on May 13, 2026, after five years of business. Owners Tierra and Ted Tyman cited growing economic issues and the extreme overhead of running a small business as reasons for the closure. The shop was known for East Coast-style sandwiches, in-house prepared meats, and a relaxed atmosphere.

Esther Rum, a women-owned premium spirits brand, has recently launched in select locations across Columbus, Ohio. Founded by Margaret Kerr-Jarrett and Emunah Winer, the Colombian-imported rum is bottled locally at Echo Spirits in Columbus. The brand aims to elevate rum's perception and appeal to consumers who typically favor tequila or other spirits.

Ted's Hot Dogs is opening its newest Chandler location on May 23, 2026, with a two-day grand opening celebration featuring giveaways, free ice cream, and Buffalo-themed festivities. The fourth-generation family-owned chain, founded in Buffalo, New York in 1927, serves charcoal-grilled hot dogs, burgers, onion rings, and milkshakes. The Chandler location will also introduce the brand's first drive-thru.

data.location: 100 Corte Madera Town Center, Corte Madera, CA 94925
data.short_description: Vietnamese fast-casual chain Asian Box is set to open at Corte Madera Town Center this fall, per a recent Instagram post by the brand. Founded in 2011 by Chad Newton and chef Gracie Nguyen, the California-based chain offers 100% gluten-free, customizable Vietnamese-inspired street food. Popular menu items include The Workout bowl and Chef Gracie's Grandma's Pho.

Ristobar, a 22-year-old Italian restaurant in San Francisco's Marina District, will close on May 25, 2026, which the team described as Memorial Day final service. The team announced on Instagram that the Chestnut Street space will continue operating as Eria Marina, a 5,300 sq. ft. indoor-outdoor events venue through a partnership with Eria Events. No specific reason for the restaurant's closure was shared.

Sushi Kobashi, led by chef Gang Lin who was part of the Michelin Star-winning team at Yoshino, is coming to the former Hana Sushi space in Chelsea. The eight-seat restaurant will specialize in an innovative omakase experience with prices starting at $250 per guest, incorporating Chinese ingredients in a nod to chef Lin's heritage. An opening date has not been announced.

The hospitality team behind Grove Street Social and Grand Street Social are planning a new elevated pub concept called Clarke & Moore Kitchen and Bar for the former Olde City Cheesesteaks & Brew space in Chelsea. The restaurant will feature a 49-person first-floor dining room and a second-floor private event space seating 74 guests. An opening date has not been announced.

data.location: 4400 Post Oak Park Dr, Houston, TX 77027
data.short_description: Mack Allen's is a new 16,000 sq. ft. fine-dining restaurant set to open in July 2026 as an anchor tenant at the 5POP office tower in the River Oaks/Uptown area. The restaurant will feature a main dining room, three private dining spaces, and a botanical garden-inspired patio. The menu will reflect a New American point of view with prime beef, wagyu, seafood, and sushi.

Lou Malnati's South Loop location has completed an approximately 2,400 sq. ft. expansion, bringing the total space to nearly 8,400+ sq. ft. The updated space includes a new full-service bar, additional dining room seating, and a private events space for up to 50 guests. The expansion was completed while the restaurant continued regular operations.

Stäge Kitchen & Bar opened its second location on May 15, 2026 inside the Element Hotel by Westin at Campus 244 in Dunwoody, after five successful years in Peachtree Corners. The restaurant offers globally inspired fusion cuisine with an omakase bar and cocktail program. Operating hours are Monday–Thursday 11am–10pm, Friday–Saturday 11am–11pm, and Sunday 11am–9pm.

McFadden's long-term vision includes expanding the concept into a brick-and-mortar location.
